inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
The iron throat screams its hollow song
Each clang of bronze pulls the dawn along
A minute gone, a shadow stretched
The village waits for the light to be fetched

[Chorus]
The bell eats the sky, it swallows the sun
Every toll is the race that's run
Break the bronze, cut the tongue
Or the morning ends where the dusk has begun

[Verse]
Keeper's hands bleed on the frozen rope
Counting seconds as the world stops
The keeper climbs through the freezing air
To silence the monster that is always there

[Chorus]
The bell eats the sky, it swallows the sun
Every toll is the race that's run
Break the bronze, cut the tongue
Or the morning ends where the dusk has begun

[Bridge]
Hammer strikes the resonant ring
The future shatters, the silence clings
One last toll, one last breath held tight
The sun is gone, swallowed by the night

[Solo]
(Twin guitars harmonize in violent A minor scales)

[Chorus]
The bell eats the sky, it swallows the sun
Every toll is the race that's run
Break the bronze, cut the tongue
Or the morning ends where the dusk has begun

[Outro]
Silence remains, the sky is dead
The keeper falls, the world is fled
